statements.text: The drivers of the $703M increase in Q2 2026 CI segment profit remain unresolved. The volume and price-realization contributions were not captured, and no manufacturing-cost driver was disclosed, which should not be read as zero. The Q1 2026 and Q4 2025 CI profit bridges also leave residuals for drivers Caterpillar did not itemize.

statements.text: Retail growth is price-neutral, based on dealer-reported unit sales and disclosed only to the whole percent, while the dealer-build figures are in current dollars. Neither is on a common basis with reported sales, so the demand reading is directional only and cannot be turned into a dollar split of sales growth. The dealer-inventory amounts rest on exact-phrase matches in the Form 10-Q filings; the surrounding sentence was not read.
